desc:
🚀 Fly to all the Planets! 🪐

Use Code: "TAKEOFF" for boosts in game! Like the Game for more codes! 👍

Someone stole your rocket… now it's time to build a better one and blast off across the solar system!

🌍 Start on Mercury and travel planet by planet all the way to PLUTO!
⚡ Click to gain SPEED and level up your rocket
🛸 Watch your rocket EVOLVE into bigger, cooler ships as you get faster
🔥 Pilot your rocket yourself: steer, boost with Turbo and land on any planet or moon
🛒 Buy upgrades in the shop to fly even faster
💤 Earn speed even while you're OFFLINE
🎮 Play fun minigames: HIT! the planet with rockets and MERGE planets to make Jupiter!
🎁 Grab bonus rewards and redeem codes for free boosts

Can you reach the edge of the solar system? 🌌

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game for more planets, rockets and updates!
👥 Join the group for an exclusive reward!

🎮 Works on PC, Mobile and Console
